overview: This House resolution expresses the House's deep sorrow at the death of Representative Doug LaMalfa of California. It directs the Clerk of the House to inform the Senate and send a copy to his family, and it has the House adjourn that day as a mark of respect. This is a traditional resolution the House adopts when a sitting member dies. The House agreed to it on January 7, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a long-standing tradition for the House to formally honor a colleague who died in office.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
